title: payload for capability learner.ability-observation.append
description: Derived from the los CLI parser for this capability's named command. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with tools/generate_capability_schemas.py.

ability.description: id of the active reviewed ability the claim is recorded against

activity.description: what was done in the recorded attempt; free text

assistance.description: optional note on assistance used during the attempt

condition.description: a condition that DID hold for this attempt

condition_not_met.description: a condition that did NOT hold; a different fact from silence, which stays unknown

confirmation_ref.description: pointer to Aram's confirmation of this claim

evidence_tag.description: evidence tag for the claim; repeatable

result.description: outcome of the recorded attempt: correct, incorrect, partial or abandoned

supersedes.description: id of the one uncorrected ability observation this record corrects; the prior bytes are preserved

workspace.description: id of the registered active workspace owning the ledger
